title: PrivacyReport
description: Per-input privacy assessment returned by the Perseverus SDK (analyze_inputs). Mirrors the Sparrow fork's PrivacyReport so every wallet renders the same model. Produced client-side: the server never sees it. Field names are snake_case to match the /v1 wire format; the Kotlin bindings expose camelCase.

status.description: graded: tag decrypted and decoded. ungraded: the funding tx is intentionally excluded by the filter build-side skip rules (dust / OP_RETURN / ordinal / runes / Counterparty) — not a privacy flag, no token spent. not_covered: no filter exists yet for the funding block height — not assessed, no token spent. error: the assessment failed (see error).

grade.description: Display grade. v3-lean tags carry a 4-way band, so values are B (band A+/A/B), C, D, F. Richer tiers may emit A+ or A. Absent unless status = graded.

grade_band.description: The raw 4-way band from the tag, for UIs that prefer it to the display grade.

score.description: 0-100. With v3-lean tags this is SYNTHESIZED per band (85/75/65/45, or 30 when the deterministic cap is set) so the number never contradicts the letter. score_is_exact tells the UI whether to show it as an exact figure.

profile.description: Transaction profile, e.g. peel-chain, coinjoin, transaction, ungraded.

findings.description: Ordered most severe first. For status = ungraded this lists the skip rules as info findings; for not_covered and error it is empty.

include_in_wallet_average.description: False for ungraded / not_covered / error so these never drag down an aggregate score.

raw_tag.description: Debug only: decoded tag as 'V3LEAN:<6 hex>', the same string the Sparrow JNI layer returns.

token_spent.description: Whether producing this report consumed a token. Inputs sharing a funding tx share one token: v5 filters are keyed per transaction.

block_height.description: Height of the funding tx's block; supplied by the wallet's own header/SPV store.

id.description: Stable am-i-exposed finding id, e.g. h3-cioh. See findings-catalog.v3lean.json.
